title: Donchian channel breakout on BTC and ETH spot, hourly
hypothesis: Turtle-style channel breakouts produce no risk-adjusted edge after realistic costs, and no detectable directional tilt across the family.

search_space.enumeration_note: 4 entry_threshold x 3 exit_rule x 3 holding_cap_bars x 6 lookback x 2 symbols = 432 fully enumerated variants. No variant is excluded after the fact. The channel is shifted one bar, so the current bar's own high cannot be part of the level it breaks. entry_threshold divides the lookback to set the exit channel.

data.source: binance public klines via data.binance.vision, see data/manifest/
data.holdout: 2025-07-01 onward — not loaded or inspected until the verdict is written

protocol.method: Fixed rules, no in-sample parameter fitting. Every variant evaluated over the full period; in-sample/out-of-sample splitting is done by CSCV at scoring time.
protocol.execution_model: signal from bar t close, held over bar t+1, no partial fills, position capped at 1x notional per side
protocol.survivorship_note: symbols fixed at the start of the period, no delisting selection

decision_rule.note: Fixed before any result was computed. Not adjustable. Run diagnose.py --null afterwards for the cross-sectional picture; that is exploratory here and must be labelled as such.

planning.sd_source: variance of trial Sharpes assumed from SW-0002; the realised value was ~3.5x larger, which raises the bar rather than lowering it
